headline: Senate resolution that would have blocked a proposed sale of certain firearms, parts, and components to Israel did not advance.
what_it_does: This joint resolution would have stopped a proposed export of certain firearms, along with their parts and components, to Israel. Congress can use this type of resolution to disapprove of arms sales that the executive branch has proposed. On July 30, 2025, the Senate voted not to move forward with it, so the proposed export was not blocked by this measure.

who_it_affects.how: Israel would not have received the specific firearms, parts, and components covered by the proposed export.

who_it_affects.group: US companies that make or sell the firearms involved
who_it_affects.how: These companies would not have been allowed to complete this particular export to Israel.
The administration's proposed approval of this arms export would have been overruled by Congress.
